statement.p: Let I=\int\!\!\int _{\mathcal{D}}(x^2-y^2)\,dx\,dy, where \mathcal{D} = \lbrace (x,y): 2\le xy\le 6, 0\le x-y\le 5, x \ge 0, y \ge 0\rbrace Show that the mapping u = xy, v = x-y maps \mathcal{D} to the rectangle \mathcal{R}=[2,6]\times [0,5].
\mathbf{(b)} Use the Change of Variables Formula to show that I is equal to the integral of f(u,v)=v over \mathcal{R} and evaluate.
